set_value.name: $psInto.$size
set_value.exact: if $psF.$ship.isclass.ship_xl then {1001, 48} else if $psF.$ship.isclass.ship_l then {1001, 49} else if $psF.$ship.isclass.ship_m then {1001, 50} else if $psF.$ship.isclass.ship_s then {1001, 51} else '-'

set_value.name: $psInto.$fleetName
set_value.exact: if (not $psF.$assist) and @$psF.$ship.subordinates.count gt 0 and @$psF.$ship.toplevelcommander == $psF.$ship then $psF.$ship.fleet.name else ''

check_value.value: event.param.isrealclass.ship and not event.param.isunit and not event.param.isrealclass.spacesuit and not event.param.ismasstraffic
if event.name == 'event_player_owned_destroyed' then event.param3 != killmethod.collected and event.param3 != killmethod.removed else event.param.isoperational

set_value.name: $pshSize
set_value.exact: if $pshT.$class == class.ship_xl then {1001, 48} else if $pshT.$class == class.ship_l then {1001, 49} else if $pshT.$class == class.ship_m then {1001, 50} else if $pshT.$class == class.ship_s then {1001, 51} else '-'

set_value.name: $psEntry
set_value.exact: table[$key = $psRecKey, $name = $psRec.$name, $idcode = $psRec.$idcode, $size = $psRec.$size, $fleetName = $psRec.$fleetName, $assist = $psRec.$assist, $cmdName = $psRec.$cmdName, $cmdIdcode = $psRec.$cmdIdcode, $cmdKey = $psRec.$cmdKey, $sectorName = $psRec.$sectorName, $sectorKey = $psRec.$sectorKey, $sectorOwner = @$psRec.$sectorOwner, $state = (if @$psRec.$gone != 'destroyed' and @$psRec.$ship.exists and not @$psRec.$ship.iswreck then 'off' else 'destroyed'), $buckets = $psRec.$buckets, $subs = [], $targets = []]

append_to_list.name: $psView.$board.$fleets
append_to_list.exact: table[$key = '$%s'.[$psBk.idcode], $name = $psBk.name, $idcode = $psBk.idcode, $marked = ($psBm != null), $refusals = (if $psBm != null then $psBm.$refusals else if $psBe.$refusals? then $psBe.$refusals else 0), $refusalWhy = (if $psBm != null then $psBm.$why else if $psBe.$refusalWhy? then $psBe.$refusalWhy else ''), $state = $psBe.$state, $target = (if @$psBe.$target.exists then '$%s'.[$psBe.$target.idcode] else ''), $why = (if @$psBe.$why != null then $psBe.$why else ''), $since = ((player.age - $psBe.$since) / 1s)i, $assigned = (if @$psBe.$assigned.exists then '$%s'.[$psBe.$assigned.idcode] else ''), $power = $psBe.$power, $share = (@$psBe.$share == true)]

append_to_list.name: $psView.$board.$targets
append_to_list.exact: table[$key = '$%s'.[$psBk.idcode], $name = $psBk.name, $idcode = $psBk.idcode, $owner = $psBk.owner.id, $size = (if $psBk.isclass.ship_xl then {1001, 48} else if $psBk.isclass.ship_l then {1001, 49} else if $psBk.isclass.ship_m then {1001, 50} else if $psBk.isclass.ship_s then {1001, 51} else '-'), $sectorName = (if @$psBk.sector.exists then $psBk.sector.knownname else '-'), $sectorKey = (if @$psBk.sector.exists then $psBk.sector.macro else '-'), $ship = $psBk, $ratio = (if (typeof $psBe.$ratio).isnumeric then $psBe.$ratio else -2), $group = $psBe.$group, $foes = $psBe.$foes, $engaged = $psBl.{1}, $pledged = $psBl.{2}, $assigned = $psBl.{3}, $help = (if $psBe.$help != null then ((player.age - $psBe.$help) / 1s)i else -1), $via = (if @$psBe.$via != null then $psBe.$via else '')]
